event.name: July 2020 South and East Asia monsoon floods
event.region: South and East Asia monsoon belt

key_values.judge_anchor: The sampled precipitation maximum is below the 1000 mm threshold; the Poyang Lake excess is a separate floodplain high-water anchor.

criteria.description: Returns the six requested fields and gives sampled_rain_below_1000mm_with_poyang_high_water_excess or an equivalent snake_case classification.
criteria.name: Final JSON and label
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2-3 points if the conclusion is correct but one field is missing or the label is not compact; give 1 point if the answer is mostly prose but the threshold failure is clear.

criteria.description: Converts 100 cm to 1000 mm and uses 491.133 mm as the maximum across the sampled precipitation diagnostics.
criteria.name: Threshold conversion and sampled maximum
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2-3 points for using the correct threshold with a non-maximum sampled value such as 466.113 mm; give 1 point for correct units but weak comparison logic.

criteria.description: Computes threshold_ratio = 0.491 and shortfall_mm = 508.867 with acceptable rounding.
criteria.name: Ratio and shortfall arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2-3 points if one derived value is correct; give 1 point if the arithmetic setup is right but the rounded numbers are off.

criteria.description: Computes 22.6 - 19.2 = 3.4 m and treats it as a separate high-water anchor.
criteria.name: Poyang high-water calculation
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for naming the two lake levels but omitting or misrounding the excess.

criteria.description: Explains that the sampled rainfall diagnostics fail the >100 cm threshold while the lake level still supports floodplain high-water conditions.
criteria.name: Consistency proof
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points if only one side of this distinction is explained.

criteria.description: Keeps the answer concise, uses the requested rounding, and avoids adding loss totals or action advice beyond the computed ledger.
criteria.name: Precision and bounded interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point if the values are mostly correct but the output is cluttered or over-interpreted.
